# Galmat Dispatch

> Galmat Dispatch (Galmat Dispatch Service LLC) is a US truck dispatch service for small trucking companies running 2 to 10 trucks. A dedicated dispatcher books loads, negotiates rates with brokers and plans reloads. Carriers get a weekly report on money, trucks and drivers. No setup fee and nothing upfront: carriers pay Galmat only after their factoring company has paid them for the delivered load.

## Service

- Who it's for: trucking companies with 2 to 10 trucks under their own MC authority
- Equipment: dry van, reefer, flatbed, step deck
- What the dispatcher does: finds loads, negotiates the rate with brokers, plans the next load before delivery so trucks don't sit
- Weekly report: gross, paid, waiting on factoring; miles, rate per mile, empty miles per truck; driver on-time record
- Payment: $0 upfront, no setup fee; the dispatch fee is paid after the factoring company pays the carrier
- Onboarding: five documents (MC/DOT authority, W-9, certificate of insurance, factoring NOA, signed dispatch agreement)
